About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions.

lists.content:
• 8+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Deep technical foundation and strong problem solving skills including the ability to create software that’s reliable, scalable, and extensible.
  • Experience developing software end to end using AI tooling such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, or something similar
  • Proven ability to learn fast, go deep, and take full ownership of complex systems.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward shipping, iteration, and measurable impact.
  • Humility, teamwork, and a drive for excellence.
  • Experience building backend or platform services in a production environment.

• Design, build, and operate services that power authentication, authorization, token management, and account security.

  • Improve service performance, scalability, and resilience across distributed systems.
  • Drive engineering excellence through thoughtful designs, clean implementations, and high quality operational practices.
  • Mentor teammates, influence cross company architecture, and contribute to a culture of curiosity, learning, and craftsmanship.

descriptionBody:
The Role
 
Join a small, high impact engineering team building the core Identity and Access Management platform that powers authentication, authorization, and security across our entire product surface. We design and operate the services behind login, service to service authentication, account protection, token management, SCIM provisioning, team management, OAuth integrations, and more. Our work sits on the critical path for every customer interaction, and we obsess over reliability, correctness, performance, and user trust.

descriptionPlain:
About the Team: 
The Escalations and Supportability team is part of the Outreach Support organization and is focused on reducing customer and internal friction by building predictable, data-driven processes that improve both customer outcomes and internal coordination. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to manage critical incidents, prevent recurrences, and drive long-term improvements in product quality and supportability.

lists.content:
• Owning complex, high-impact, and executive-visible customer escalations from initial triage through full resolution 

  • Strong strategic judgment in driving escalation and incident resolution, including the ability to identify the right stakeholders, build effective cross-functional partnerships, frame tradeoffs clearly, and align Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success around durable troubleshooting paths and long-term risk reduction. 

  • Leading coordination with internal stakeholders including Customer Success, Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Support to maintain alignment through every stage of the escalation lifecycle and resolve gaps in ownership, priority, communication, or decision-making 

  •  Leading and maturing the global Incident Management Program and ensuring consistent response standards across all incident severities

•  7+ years of experience in technical escalation management, incident management, technical account management, or a similar customer-facing function 

  • Able to communicate effectively at multiple levels—translating complex technical detail for senior executives while engaging deeply with engineers and support teams to drive alignment, decisions, and accountability 

  • Proven track record of managing complex customer escalations and large-scale incident responses with confidence and credibility across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams 

  • Experience engaging directly with executives and cross-functional leadership in high-pressure situations with executive presence, concise communication, sound judgment, and clear recommendations

lists.content:
• Renewal Execution: Manage renewal notifications and customer communications, making sure each one is action at each of the key milestones. Partner with AMs during weekly renewal reviews and escalations. 

  • Save Motion: Partner with Sales (Account Managers and Sales Leaders), Revenue Operations, BI, and Support to save renewals when a customer is at risk or has told us they intend to leave.

  • Forecasting and Reporting: Maintain forecast accuracy by updating renewal values and risk indicators. Identify churn, contraction, and renewal risks early. Maintain strong CRM hygiene and renewal documentation. 

  • Process and Program Design: Design, maintain, evaluate, and iterate team workflows, using customer feedback to build processes that improve the customer experience.

• 2 plus years of experience in a SaaS environment.

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Curious about AI and eager to apply it in practical ways. 

  • Experience developing processes and programs which optimize the customer experience or positively influence renewals process. 

  • Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to work independently and engage confidently across all levels of the organization.

  • Experience managing forecasts and metrics.
